# Decor Events Hire

> Decor Events Hire is a Sydney, Australia business offering wedding and event furniture and décor hire: Tiffany chairs, tables, linen, flower walls, backdrops, draping and styled packages, delivered and set up across the Sydney metropolitan area and south-western Sydney, NSW.

- Website: https://decoreventshire.com.au
- Phone: +61 420 474 372
- Email: info@decoreventshire.com.au
- Address: 68 Blaxland Rd, Campbelltown NSW 2560, Australia (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Decor+Events+Hire+68+Blaxland+Rd+Campbelltown+NSW+2560)
- Service area: Sydney metropolitan & south-western suburbs (Liverpool, Campbelltown, Camden, Narellan, Oran Park, Leppington, Fairfield, Bankstown, Parramatta, Penrith, Blacktown, Sutherland, Hurstville, Sydney CBD, Inner West, Hills District)
- Hours: Mon–Sat, 8am–6pm · Sun by appointment
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/decoreventshire
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/share/1CXwCywpCw/
- Prices are shown online per item; delivery, setup and pack-down are quoted per job.

## Hire categories
- [Chairs](https://decoreventshire.com.au/hire/chairs/): Tiffany, Americana, gladiator and folding chairs, plus cushions.
- [Tables](https://decoreventshire.com.au/hire/tables/): Trestle and round tables for banquets, receptions and parties.
- [Linen](https://decoreventshire.com.au/hire/linen/): Tablecloths, runners and napkins in classic colours.
- [Décor & Backdrops](https://decoreventshire.com.au/hire/decor/): Arches, flower walls, neon signs, plinths and table styling.
- [Draping & Lighting](https://decoreventshire.com.au/hire/draping-lighting/): Ceiling draping, sheer backdrops and fairy-light curtains.
- [Bar Stools](https://decoreventshire.com.au/hire/bar-stools/): Seating for bars, cocktail areas and dessert stations.

## Frequently asked questions
### How does the quote cart work?
Add the items and quantities you need, then send your event details. It's a request, not a payment. We confirm availability for your date and reply with your final quote.

### Are delivery and setup included in the prices?
Item prices are for hire only. Delivery, setup and pack-down are quoted per job, based on your suburb, venue access and timing.

### Which areas do you service?
The Sydney metropolitan area and the south-western suburbs. If you're unsure whether we cover your venue, just ask.

### How far ahead should I book?
As early as you can, especially for spring and summer weekends. Booking 6 or more months ahead also qualifies you for our early-bird discount.

### How do I secure my booking?
Once you accept your quote, a 30% deposit secures your date. The balance is due 7 days before your event.

### Can I mix packages with individual items?
Absolutely. Add a package to your cart, then add any extra chairs, linen or décor you need.

### Can I change quantities after booking?
Usually, yes. Let us know as soon as possible and we'll update your quote, subject to availability.

### Do you set up outdoors and in backyards?
Yes. We set up in backyards, parks, halls and venues. Let us know about stairs, long carries or uneven ground so we can plan ahead.

### What if an item is damaged?
Normal wear is fine. Items that are lost or damaged beyond repair are charged at replacement cost, and we'll always talk it through with you first.

### Can I pick up the items myself?
Pick-up may be possible for smaller orders. Mention it in your quote request and we'll let you know.

## How to book
Add items to the quote cart at https://decoreventshire.com.au/quote/ and send your event date, suburb and guest numbers, or call 0420 474 372. Availability and the final quote are confirmed personally.
